notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Released
notes.content:
🔥 Hello, Guardians of the Vessel!
This week, we’ve been hard at work bringing you a fresh batch of exciting updates! From gameplay-enhancing features to crucial performance improvements, we’ve got a lot to share. Here’s a breakdown of everything new in this update:

🕷️ New Enemy Skins
Enemies now have a whole new look! We’ve added fresh and diverse visual designs to enemy types, making them more distinct and memorable. Each enemy has its own unique appearance, adding more depth to the world and making every encounter feel fresh.

⚔️ Enemy Indicators
To improve your battlefield awareness, we’ve added enemy indicators. These markers will help you identify which enemies are preparing to attack, charging special abilities, or targeting you directly. Stay sharp and strategize accordingly!

⚙️ Collision Optimizations
Smooth performance is key, and we’ve made big improvements to the collision system. With these optimizations, you’ll experience fewer hiccups and a much more fluid gameplay experience. Combat-heavy moments will now feel faster, sharper, and more responsive.

🌿 Environment Art Enhancements
Immerse yourself in a richer, more vibrant world! We’ve updated the environmental art with new elements like foliage, textures, and small visual details to make every scene feel more alive. Each location will now have a greater sense of depth and atmosphere.

🕸️ Enemy Nests
Enemy Nests are here! These new points of interest are hubs where enemies spawn in waves. Players will have the opportunity to clear these nests for valuable rewards — but be prepared, as they won’t go down without a fight. It’s a high-risk, high-reward challenge!

🌊 Enemy Wave Tuning
We’ve rebalanced the enemy wave system to create a more engaging and fair challenge. Enemy waves will now feel more dynamic, with better pacing and a balanced increase in intensity. Whether you’re a new player or a seasoned veteran, the experience will feel more rewarding.
✨ Spell Enhancements
Several spells have been updated to make them more powerful, impactful, and fun to use. Some spells now have enhanced effects, while others have been rebalanced to offer more strategic value. Your magical arsenal is stronger than ever!

🔮 Final Words
With this update, we’re improving both the look and feel of the game. From enemy variety to environmental beauty and gameplay depth, this update has something for everyone. Don’t forget to share your thoughts — your feedback helps us make the game even better!

Thank you for your support, and see you in the next update!
– The Kozegu Team
